speaker: richard_field
text: I am not walking anywhere while that is on thy knee. I have said so. A lane is a lane, and an open leaf is a reason to stay in a chair.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Non. I am in the other chair, and I am not a second audience. When you shut it, the house can be a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It shuts as it is. Not yet. I want the light on the line once more, and then I am done with it for tonight.
